title: 第304章  方玄弟弟，别来无恙！
content_zh:
“真人，可算是找到你了。”
沙哑声音响起，只见一名瘦弱老妪，从虚空中缓缓浮现而出，挡在陆法和方玄中间。
“尹婆婆？”
老妪的出现，顿时让陆法惊了一下。
他眉头紧皱，沉声道：“尹婆婆，你也认识玄天道友？”
“真人是我家小姐托了关系，请来替小小姐检查身体的，老身当然认识。”
尹婆婆看向陆法，板起脸说道：“陆法，你刚才是想要向真人动手？”
陆法心中咯噔一声。
这玄天道友，竟然是家主陆昭请来的？
如此一来，那就说得通了。
“尹婆婆误会了。”
陆法呵呵一笑，说道：“老夫刚才是想要请玄天真人帮个忙，抓住放火焚烧李家府邸的凶手。”
“李家？”
尹婆婆冷笑一声，说道：“一群自作自受的小人罢了，死就死了，如何与我家的安危小小姐相比？”
感受到尹婆婆身上的隐隐流转的气息，陆法心中再次一沉。
“尹婆婆说得是。”
他主动后移半步，说道：“既然如此，那就不耽搁两位的正事了。”
虽说陆法是公子陆仁的人，但整个四海商会，明面上的掌权者，却是陆昭。
这个毫无修为的女流之辈，在经商方面的天赋，连陆法都叹为观止，惊为天人。
加上陆昭执掌家族多年，忠心于她的人，不在少数。

除了尹婆婆这位修为不比他低的强者外，谁也不知道，她这些年积攒了多少力量。
即便公子已经谋划多年，但还不到和对方撕破脸皮的时候。
特别是涉及到陆昭的独女，陆法更不敢继续为难方玄了。
“真人，随老身走吧。”
尹婆婆朝着方玄微微一笑，说道：“我家小姐已经备好酒菜，替真人接风洗尘。”
“如此，那就有劳了。”
方玄一甩拂尘，点头答应下来。
虽然他不知道尹婆婆为何会配合他演戏，但他从对方身上并未感受到半点恶意。
从刚才她与陆法的对话中，不难猜出两人之间，并不和睦，甚至还隐隐有些矛盾。
本着敌人的敌人，就是朋友这一心态，选择跟这个尹婆婆走，无疑是正确的选择。
对方真要有什么目的，大不了召唤赤鳞，强行离开就是了。
陆法的目光，一直放在方玄身上。
并非是他发现眼前的这个玄天真人，就是他苦苦寻找的方玄。
而是觉得，对方出现的时机和目的，过于巧合了。
他最担心的是，方玄会不会是陆昭请来的帮手。
“对了。”
尹婆婆脚步突然一顿，侧身看向陆法。
“陆法，老身不过是小姐身边的一个仆人，许多话其实不该由我来说。”
尹婆婆语气平静的说道：“但有些事情，还希望你能够三思而行，莫要将来后悔。”
陆法眼睛一眯，看向尹婆婆。

他当然明白尹婆婆是什么意思，这是告诉他，他和陆仁做的那些事情，陆昭已经知道了。
“多谢提醒。”
陆法叹了口气，语气复杂的说道：“只是各为其主，老夫别无选择。”
“那就......保重。”
尹婆婆点点头，对方玄说道：“真人，请！”
目送方玄和尹婆婆离去，陆法的神情却是阴晴不定。
“大长老，怎么了？”
周长老语气有些忐忑。
“没什么。”
陆法摆摆手，说道：“回去吧，守好城门，做好公子交代的事情。”
“那纵火之人呢？”
“不必理会。”
陆法说道：“三名实力不在我之下的强者，只要不是冲着我们来的，随他们去。”
“是！”
周长老离开后，陆法却是暗自叹了口气。
“看来，陆家要变天了。”
......
“前辈，不知......”
跟在尹婆婆身后飞行的了一段距离，方玄没忍住开口。
“真人莫急，等见到我家小姐，你就明白了。”

尹婆婆直接打断方玄的话，笑呵呵的说道：“而且，真人的朋友现在很安全，不用担心。”
李观澜？
方玄心中一沉。
看来，他的身份，已经被这位尹婆婆看穿了。
但既然对方已经暗示他，李观澜在对方手上。
那么就算是龙潭虎穴，方玄也必须走一趟了。
不多时，尹婆婆就带着方玄，横跨半个明月郡，径直飞入一座大山。
大山上空，雾气翻滚，根本看不清山中景况。
“遮云阵？”
方玄眉头一挑，说道：“好大的手笔，此阵非阵法宗师，根本无法布置。”
“真人好眼力。”
尹婆婆笑道：“此阵确实一位阵法宗师亲手布置。”
“婆婆就莫要取笑晚辈了。”
方玄无奈的说道：“晚辈眼力再好，在婆婆面前，不也被一眼看穿？”
尹婆婆只是呵呵一笑，并不接话。
只见她手掌一挥，雾气翻滚，露出一条通道。
两人顺着通道，钻入阵法之中。
映入方玄眼帘的，是一片硕大的庄园。
假山流水，阁楼凉亭，一派大气磅礴的气象。
在凉亭下，坐着一位姿容端庄的丰腴女子。

气质柔和，却又隐隐带着久居上位的威严。
虽然早就有所猜测，但在看到对方的时候，方玄也是有些意外。
方玄上前两步，双手抱拳，行了一礼。
“方玄，多谢陆家主出手相助。”
同时，他心中也彻底松了口气。
既然是陆昭，那就暂时就不用担心陆法他们的报复了。
“方玄弟弟，别来无恙啊。”
陆昭掩嘴一笑，说道：“快过来坐。”
方玄点点头，又对尹婆婆躬身一拜：“之前，多谢婆婆解围，晚辈感激不尽。”
“无妨无妨。”
尹婆婆慈祥一笑，说道：“公子先稍作休息，老身这就去准备饭菜。”
“劳烦婆婆了。”
方玄又行了礼，这才走进凉亭，在陆昭面前坐下。
“玄天真人？”
望着眼前的方玄，陆昭突然噗嗤笑出声来，说道：“方玄弟弟何时拜入玄门了？”
“陆家主就别打趣我了。”
方玄哭笑不得的说道：“无奈之举罢了。”
“和姐姐这么见外？”
陆昭眼波流转，隐隐带着三分幽怨。
今日的陆昭，穿一身浅色家居衣裙，青丝盘成一个发髻，露出白皙的脖颈。

不知是无意还是有意，一缕青丝，绕过脖颈，恰好垂在爆满的胸脯之上，随着陆昭的呼吸，一起一伏。
在方玄认识的女子之中。
李天骄英气十足，不让须眉。
蓝媚儿魅惑天成，城府极深。
萧锦鱼清冷如月，外冷内热。
李观澜淡然如水，内心坚韧。
至于陆昭，给方玄的印象又大为不同。
一会儿如邻家大姐，一会儿似空谷幽兰，一会儿又威严如山。
“小流氓，看够了没？”
见方玄盯着自己看，陆昭娇嗔一句。
虽然她已经诞下一女，实则年纪不大，加上又保养极好，最是女人最妩媚迷人的年纪。
她这一小女儿的神态，不仅没有半点娇柔做作，反而更让人目眩神迷，难以自已。
好在方玄道心坚韧，很快就回过神来。
他也不尴尬，只是说道：“陆昭姐，我朋友她......”
“她受了点伤，但没什么大碍，如今正在闭关之中。”
生怕方玄不信，陆昭取出一枚留音符，递给方玄。
“这是她闭关之前交给你的。”
方玄拿起留音符，神魂注入其中，李观澜的声音便在耳边响起。
“等我出关再说。”
简简单单的一句话，却让方玄彻底放下心来。

“陆昭姐，这次真是多谢了。”
方玄郑重其事的说道：“要不是你出手，我和观澜可能已经......”
“啧，观澜，叫得这么亲热？”
陆昭红唇一启，美眸在方玄身上流转，说道：“又是你的红颜知己？”
“陆昭姐，你可别乱说，我和她......”
“你是想说，你们是清白的吗？”
陆昭接过话头，笑嘻嘻的说道：“真要清白，会直接当众抢婚，还不惜得罪顾家和四海商会？”
方玄不说话了。
“你这小家伙还真是个多情种啊。”
陆昭眯眼一笑，说道：“锦鱼，知道吗？”
方玄揉了揉太阳穴，脑袋有些疼。
见到方玄如此模样，陆昭顿时拍桌大笑。
花枝乱颤，波涛汹涌。
笑声豪迈，毫无半点家主会长形象。
方玄默念无量天尊，谨守心神。
“方玄弟弟，说个正事。”
收起笑容，陆昭一脸正容的说道：“姐姐这次可能需要你帮忙了。”
“陆昭姐救我一次，方玄自当报答。”
方玄也正色道：“能力范围，义不容辞。”
“有你这句话，姐姐就放心了。”

陆昭点点头，说道：“你应该也看出来了，如今四海商会和陆家，外表光鲜，实则内忧外患，千疮百孔。”
“陆昭姐，你是想让我帮你清理那些不听话的家伙？”
方玄皱眉道：“只是以我目前的实力，怕是力有未逮。”
“方玄弟弟，你不必妄自菲薄。”
陆昭说道：“能和李观澜，灭了李家，斩杀顾家多位长老，连陆法他们都拿你无可奈何，你的实力，毋庸置疑。”
“陆昭姐就不担心，我的身份要是被揭穿，不仅帮不了忙，反而会为你带来麻烦？”
面对方玄的反问，陆昭却是早有准备。
“你不是叫玄天吗？还有什么身份？”
看着眨巴眼眸的陆昭，方玄先是一愣，随即摇头笑道：“没想到陆昭姐连这一步都想到了。”
“说说吧，具体什么事。”
陆昭深吸一口气，一字一句道：“我要你，帮我杀了陆仁！”
content_en:
"Zhenmao, I finally found you."
A hoarse voice sounded, and a thin old woman slowly emerged from the void, blocking the way between Lu Fa and Fang Xuan.
"Grandma Yin?"
The appearance of the old woman immediately shocked Lu Fa.
He frowned and said in a deep voice: "Grandma Yin, do you also know fellow Taoist Xuantian?"
"The real person was asked by my young lady to check her body. Of course I know her."
Granny Yin looked at Lu Fa and said with a straight face: "Lu Fa, did you just want to attack Zhenren?"
Lu Fa's heart skipped a beat.
This fellow Taoist Xuantian was actually invited by the head of the family, Lu Zhao?
In that case, it makes sense.
"Grandma Yin misunderstood."
Lu Fa chuckled and said, "I just wanted to ask Mr. Xuantian for a favor and catch the murderer who set fire to the Li family's mansion."
"Li family?"
Granny Yin sneered and said: "They are just a bunch of self-inflicted villains. They will die if they die. How can they compare with the safe little lady of my family?"
Lu Fa's heart sank again when he felt the faintly flowing aura of Granny Yin.
"Grandma Yin is right."
He took the initiative to take half a step back and said, "In that case, let's not delay the business of the two of you."
Although Lu Fa belongs to the son Lu Ren, the official leader of the entire Sihai Chamber of Commerce is Lu Zhao.
Even Lu Fa was astonished by this uncultivated female generation's talent in business.
In addition, Lu Zhao has been in charge of the family for many years, and there are many people who are loyal to her.
Except for Granny Yin, a strong person whose cultivation level is no lower than his, no one knows how much strength she has accumulated over the years.
Even though the young master has been planning for many years, it is not yet time to break up with the other party.
Especially when it came to Lu Zhao's only daughter, Lu Fa did not dare to continue to embarrass Fang Xuan.
"Ma'am, just go as you are."
Granny Yin smiled slightly at Fang Xuan and said, "My lady has prepared wine and food to take care of the real person."
"If so, then it will be hard work."
Fang Xuan shook his fly whisk and nodded in agreement.
Although he didn't know why Grandma Yin would cooperate with him in acting, he didn't feel any malice from her.
From the conversation between her and Lu Fa just now, it is not difficult to guess that there is no harmony between the two, and there are even some contradictions.
Based on the mentality that the enemy of my enemy is my friend, choosing to go with Granny Yin is undoubtedly the right choice.
If the other party really has some purpose, the worst they can do is summon Red Scale and forcefully leave.
Lu Fa's eyes were always on Fang Xuan.
It wasn't that he discovered that the Xuantian in front of him was the Fang Xuan he was looking for.
Instead, I felt that the timing and purpose of the other party's appearance were too coincidental.
What he was most worried about was whether Fang Xuan was the helper invited by Lu Zhao.
"Right."
Grandma Yin suddenly stopped in her steps and looked sideways at Lu Fa.
"Lu Fa, I am just a servant beside the young lady. There are many things that I should not say."
Granny Yin said calmly: "But there are some things that I hope you can think twice about before you act and don't regret it in the future."
Lu Fa narrowed his eyes and looked at Granny Yin.
Of course he understood what Grandma Yin meant, which was telling him that Lu Zhao already knew about the things he and Lu Ren did.
"Thanks for the reminder."
Lu Fa sighed and said in a complicated tone: "Everyone is their own master, I have no choice."
"Then...take care."
Granny Yin nodded and said to Fang Xuan: "Master, please!"
As he watched Fang Xuan and Granny Yin leave, Lu Fa's expression was uncertain.
"Great Elder, what's wrong?"
Elder Zhou's tone was a little uneasy.
"Nothing."
Lu Fa waved his hand and said, "Go back, guard the city gate, and do what the master has told you."
"What about the person who set the fire?"
"Don't bother."
Lu Fa said: "ThreeA strong person whose strength is not inferior to mine, as long as they are not coming for us, let them go. "
"yes! "
After Elder Zhou left, Lu Fa sighed secretly.
“It seems that things are going to change for the Lu family. "
...
"Senior, I don't know..."
After flying some distance behind Granny Yin, Fang Xuan couldn't help but speak.
"Don't be impatient, you will understand when you meet my young lady. "
Granny Yin directly interrupted Fang Xuan's words and said with a smile: "Besides, Zhenren's friends are safe now, don't worry. "
Li Guanlan?
Fang Xuan's heart sank.
It seems that his identity has been seen through by Granny Yin.
But since the other party has hinted at him, Li Guanlan is in the hands of the other party.
Then even if it is the Dragon Pond and the Tiger's Den, Fang Xuan must visit it.
Not long after, Granny Yin took Fang Xuan across half of Mingyue County and flew straight into a big mountain.
The fog was rolling over the mountains, making it impossible to see the scenery in the mountains.
"Cloud-covering array? "
Fang Xuan raised his eyebrows and said: "What a great effort. This formation cannot be arranged at all unless you are a master of formations. "
“You really have good eyesight. "
Granny Yin smiled and said: "This formation was indeed arranged by a formation master himself. "
"Mother-in-law, please don't make fun of the younger generation. "
Fang Xuan said helplessly: "No matter how good my eyesight is, in front of my mother-in-law, won't I be seen through at a glance? "
Granny Yin just laughed and didn't answer.
She waved her palm, and the mist rolled, revealing a passage.
The two of them followed the passage and got into the formation.
What caught Fang Xuan's eyes was a huge manor.
Rockeries, flowing water, attic pavilions, and a majestic atmosphere.
Under the pavilion, a plump woman with a dignified appearance sat.
He has a gentle temperament, but also has a vague majesty that has been in a position of power for a long time.
Although he had already guessed it, Fang Xuan was a little surprised when he saw the other party.
Fang Xuan took two steps forward, cupped his fists with both hands, and saluted.
"Fang Xuan, thank you Master Lu for your help. "
At the same time, he was completely relieved.
Since it is Lu Zhao, there is no need to worry about Lu Fa's revenge for the time being.
"Brother Fang Xuan, you are fine. "
Lu Zhao covered his mouth with a smile and said, "Come here and sit down. "
Fang Xuan nodded, and bowed to Granny Yin again: "Previously, I would like to thank you for rescuing Granny, I am very grateful to you. "
“It doesn’t matter, it doesn’t matter. "
Granny Yin smiled kindly and said, "Young Master, please take a short rest first, and I will go prepare the food right now. "
"Excuse me, mother-in-law. "
Fang Xuan saluted again, then walked into the pavilion and sat down in front of Lu Zhao.
"My lord Xuantian? "
Looking at Fang Xuan in front of him, Lu Zhao suddenly burst into laughter and said, "When did younger brother Fang Xuan join the Xuanmen? "
"Master Lu, please stop teasing me. "
Fang Xuan said dumbfounded: "It's just a helpless move. "
"You and your sister are like this? "
Lu Zhao's eyes flickered, with a hint of resentment.
Today, Lu Zhao is wearing a light-colored home dress, with her black hair tied into a bun, revealing her fair neck.
Whether it was accidental or intentional, a strand of black hair went around the neck and just hung on the bustling chest. It rose and fell with Lu Zhao's breathing.
Among the women Fang Xuan knew.
Li Tianjiao is full of heroic spirit and does not show off his eyebrows.
Lan Meier is charming and charming, and the city is extremely deep.
Xiao Jinyu is as cold as the moon, cold on the outside and hot on the inside.
Li Guanlan is as calm as water and has a tough heart.
As for Lu Zhao, his impression on Fang Xuan was completely different.
One moment, she is like the elder sister next door, another moment, she is like an orchid in an empty valley, and the next moment, she is as majestic as a mountain.
"You little gangster, have you seen enough? "
Seeing Fang Xuan staring at him, Lu Zhaojiao said angrily.
Although she has already given birth to a daughter, she is actually not very old, and she is well-maintained, making her the most charming and charming age for a woman.
Not only is her little daughter's demeanor not at all delicate and artificial, but it is even more dazzling and difficult to control.already.
Fortunately, Fang Xuandao had a strong heart and quickly came to his senses.
He was not embarrassed and just said: "Sister Lu Zhao, my friend..."
"She was a little injured, but nothing serious. She is currently in seclusion."
Afraid that Fang Xuan wouldn't believe it, Lu Zhao took out a note and handed it to Fang Xuan.
"This was given to you before she went into seclusion."
Fang Xuan picked up the note, poured his soul into it, and Li Guanlan's voice rang in his ears.
"We'll talk about it after I get out of seclusion."
This simple sentence made Fang Xuan completely relieved.
"Sister Lu Zhao, thank you so much this time."
Fang Xuan said solemnly: "If you hadn't taken action, Guanlan and I might have..."
"Tsk, Guanlan, are you shouting so affectionately?"
Lu Zhao's red lips parted, his beautiful eyes wandered over Fang Xuan, and he said, "Is this your confidante again?"
"Sister Lu Zhao, please don't talk nonsense, she and I..."
"Are you trying to say that you are innocent?"
Lu Zhao took over the conversation and said with a smile: "If you really want to be innocent, will you directly steal the marriage in public, and not hesitate to offend the Gu family and the Sihai Chamber of Commerce?"
Fang Xuan stopped talking.
"You are such a passionate little guy."
Lu Zhao narrowed his eyes and smiled, and said, "Jinyu, do you know?"
Fang Xuan rubbed his temples, his head hurt a little.
Seeing Fang Xuan looking like this, Lu Zhao suddenly slapped the table and laughed.
The flower branches are trembling and the waves are turbulent.
The laughter was bold and heroic, without any image of the head of the family.
Fang Xuan silently remembered the Infinite Heavenly Lord and guarded his mind.
"Brother Fang Xuan, let's talk about business."
Putting away his smile, Lu Zhao said with a serious face: "Sister, I may need your help this time."
"Sister Lu Zhao saved me once, and Fang Xuan should repay me."
Fang Xuan also said seriously: "Within the scope of my abilities, I have no obligation to do so."
"With your words, my sister will feel relieved."
Lu Zhao nodded and said, "You should have noticed that the Sihai Chamber of Commerce and the Lu family are now glamorous on the outside, but in reality they are riddled with internal and external troubles."
"Sister Lu Zhao, do you want me to help you clean up those disobedient guys?"
Fang Xuan frowned and said, "It's just that with my current strength, I'm afraid it's not enough."
"Brother Fang Xuan, you don't have to belittle yourself."
Lu Zhao said: "Being able to destroy the Li family with Li Guanlan and kill many elders of the Gu family, even Lu Fa and the others are helpless against you, there is no doubt about your strength."
"Sister Lu Zhao, aren't you worried? If my identity is exposed, not only will I not be able to help, but it will bring you trouble?"
Facing Fang Xuan's rhetorical question, Lu Zhao was already prepared.
"Isn't your name Xuan Tian? What else is your identity?"
Looking at Lu Zhao who was blinking his eyes, Fang Xuan was stunned for a moment, then shook his head and said with a smile: "I didn't expect Sister Lu Zhao to even think of this step."
"Tell me what it is."
Lu Zhao took a deep breath and said word by word: "I want you to help me kill Lu Ren!"
